decisions.decision: Cross-sectional IC (symbol='POOLED') is correct model for ensemble - per-symbol cells structurally impossible below IC Sharpe gate
decisions.rationale: Per-symbol per-regime has ~1,500 bars at 5m, need 60,000 for gate. Cross-sectional pools 58 symbols × regime = ~126K bars → 220 windows, well above gate.

decisions.decision: ensemble_weights use symbol='UNIVERSE' sentinel (universe-level weights, not per-symbol)
decisions.rationale: One rigorous cross-sectional model vs 58 noisy per-symbol models. Symbol column not nullable in current schema; sentinel parallels 'POOLED' pattern in feature_ic_scores.

decisions.decision: alpha_publisher cache key changed from (symbol, tf, regime) to (tf, regime)
decisions.rationale: ensemble_weights.symbol is always 'UNIVERSE' after redesign; including symbol in cache key causes every lookup to miss when actual ticker symbol is used for lookup.
